title: MVP V4-5 CLI/TUI/wallet operator policy path
brief: Expose the V4 policy runtime to operators: CLI commands for V4 init extension and PolicyTx lifecycle, wallet/cosign path for owner+rescue signing, inspection of active/dormant/finalized/rescue state in CLI/TUI/API docs, and examples for structured policy rejects. Keep mutation UX minimal and do not imply full governance or membership features.

delegations.prompt_summary: Prepare reuse map for V4-5 CLI/TUI/wallet operator path, files, symbols, risks, and test commands.
Implement V4-5 operator path: CLI tx-policy/init_v4/rescue-cosign commands, TUI/API inspection fields, docs, and pwmd version marker.
Validate V4-5 CLI/TUI/API operator path with cargo checks, CLI parse tests, docs command names, and help smoke.
Add V4-5 CLI coverage: tx-policy-deactivate parse, external rescue signer parse, and subprocess help smoke.
Retest V4-5 after additional CLI parse/help tests; check pwm-cli, pwm-tui, and pwmd.
Independent review of V4-5 CLI/TUI/wallet operator path and docs/API compatibility.
Auto-close review documentation nits: mark_amount u32, rescue-cosign emergency-only warning, rescue-wallet default signer warning, and TUI poll detail fields.
Final re-review after V4-5 documentation nit fixes.

notes: Operator-path slice. Product code changes must go through pwm-coding -> pwm-testing -> pwm-review. Do not expand into full org registry, governance, or policy DSL.
